statement: joycond combines a left and right hid-nintendo Joy-Con into a uinput device named 'Nintendo Switch Combined Joy-Cons' with VID 057e, PID 0x2008 and BUS_VIRTUAL. Bluetooth halves pair only after a user gesture (one shoulder button on each half; both shoulders on one half selects a lone controller, SL+SR selects horizontal mode). Charging Grip halves always wait for a partner. Its udev rules tag the physical main event nodes and restrict them to mode 0600.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in the cited source records; host versions not measured
applicability.scope: joycond source and udev rules only; no host run. The combined device is a userspace construct; 0x2008 is not a product ID of any Joy-Con hardware in the kernel ID table.
